title: chore: Fix #6692 update hogan.js to remove deprecated package mkdirp
body:
**Summary**

Hello,
Current instantsearch.js embed hogan.js as dependency which used mkdirp, which triggers a deprecated warning.
It's a small change but my team and I would like to avoid install deprecated packages in production.

Therefore I have forked hogan.js to use native nodejs and remove the mkdirp packages.
All tests are running correctly for hogan.js.

Let me know if that can be of any help
